free_tier.stated: A trial of $0 for 7 days with 2 sandboxes at once, giving $0.90 of sandbox time, 25 hours of 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB, that needs a card to start; after the trial every sandbox needs a paid plan.
free_tier.notes: The $0.90 credit at the default 2 vCPU and 4 GiB rate of $0.018 an hour is 50 hours; the docs quote 25 hours of the larger 4 vCPU and 8 GiB size. The free tier for model inference on spare capacity with a verified phone is a separate offer and is recorded under inference/munito.

per_object_cap.stated: 100 MiB per file written through the sandbox file API
per_object_cap.notes: The unit is a machine, not a stored object; the file limit is the closest published per-item ceiling.

retention.stated: A sandbox lives 10 to 86,400 seconds and defaults to 3,600 seconds; at most 7,200 seconds during the trial. A paused persistent sandbox keeps files and processes while its saved state bills at $0.0002 per GiB-hour.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress price or allowance is published for sandboxes; a new sandbox has no outbound internet access until internet is set to true, and inbound reaches it only through ports and SSH

record.interface_detail: A TypeScript client and an npm CLI create sandboxes, run commands and write files through a REST API; shells, SSH, open ports and a desktop are available inside a sandbox.
record.tooling: npm install -g @munitoai/cli, then munito login, munito create, munito exec and munito rm; the TypeScript client is @munitoai/cli.
record.chaining: A 2 vCPU and 4 GiB sandbox at $0.018 an hour supplies an isolated Linux machine for agents; a paused persistent sandbox keeps a warmed toolchain for forks, and files must be copied to a separate object-storage record for long-term retention.

record.limits_note: During the trial an organization runs 2 sandboxes at once, each at most 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB; command runs last 1 to 1,800 seconds. A new sandbox starts with no outbound internet access.
record.binding_note: The $0.90 credit for 7 days runs out before the 8,000-per-minute IP rate or the per-file cap does.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up offers GitHub, Google or email (https://console.munito.ai/registration). The sandbox trial needs a card saved on the Billing page: 'Add a card to start' and 'To start, add a card on the Billing page of the console. The card is not charged then.' No phone or identity document is asked for to start a sandbox; a verified phone appears only on the separate model-inference free tier.

record.reliability_note: A create, resume, fork or new timeout is refused with 402 if there is no card, no plan or no credit; when the trial credit runs out, running sandboxes stop with end_reason credits. Sandboxes on one host share its vCPUs, so a busy host slows commands.
record.confidence_note: The plan table, trial credit, rates, limits and card gate are read from the vendor's pricing and sandbox-pricing pages on 2026-11-25 and quoted below. The egress price was not published and is left unverified.

free_tier.stated: The trial gives $0.90 of sandbox time for 7 days; during it the organization runs 2 sandboxes at once, each at most 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB with a timeout of at most 7,200 seconds. A card is added to start and is not charged then. Separate from sandboxes, the inference service has a free tier on spare capacity for a new account with a verified phone number, with daily token limits.
free_tier.notes: USD 0.90 of time at USD 0.018 an hour for the default 2 vCPU / 4 GiB size is 50 hours; quota is in credits and metered by the second. The inference free tier belongs to the separate inference offer and its daily cap is 2,000,000 tokens for four named chat models and 4,000,000 for each other chat model.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a machine, not an object; the largest custom size is 16 vCPUs and 32,768 MiB, and a file write is at most 100 MiB

retention.stated: A sandbox runs until its timeout or a delete and its files go with a delete; a persistent sandbox keeps files and processes across a pause and its saved state is priced at $0.0002 per GiB-hour while the sandbox runs and while it is paused.

egress.terms: A new sandbox has no outbound internet access; setting "internet": true enables it, and SMTP mail is not available. Inbound connections come only through ports and SSH. No outbound volume allowance or per-TB price is published.

record.interface_detail: An OpenAI-compatible REST API creates sandboxes, runs commands and reads and writes files; a CLI runs a coding agent in a sandbox with one command; SSH takes public keys and no password, and public ports are exposed at a URL per port.
record.tooling: the REST API, the Python and TypeScript SDKs and the munito command line tool; a sandbox starts from a base, ubuntu, agent or desktop template or a custom container image
record.chaining: A paid plan after the trial sets how many sandboxes run at once (50 for Starter, 2,000 for Fleet) and pays its price back as credits; the same credit balance pays the open-model inference API, so a job chain can run code and call a model without a second vendor, and outputs must be written to another record's storage to survive a sandbox delete.

limits.value: $0.90 of sandbox time over 7 days; usage past the card-free trial needs a plan
2 sandboxes at once during the trial; each at most 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB and a timeout of at most 7,200 seconds; 8,000 API requests a minute from one IP

record.limits_note: A sandbox runs for 10 to 86,400 seconds and 7,200 at most during the trial. A command runs at most 1,800 seconds, writes a file of at most 100 MiB and returns at most 1 MiB per stream.
record.binding_note: The USD 0.90 credit, 50 hours at the default size, ends within the 7-day window and stops the sandboxes when used up, before the concurrency and per-command caps bind a single job.

identity_cost.detail: Adding a card on the Billing page starts the trial and is not charged then; the card requires 3D Secure in some jurisdictions. Registration offers email, Google and GitHub sign-in. The separate inference free tier requires a verified phone number, which the sandbox trial does not state.

record.reliability_note: A sandbox that reaches its timeout or whose credits run out stops; with automatic top-up off, the sandboxes stop when the balance is spent. Sandboxes on one host share its vCPUs, so a busy host slows a command, and a create above the plan's concurrency gets 429.
record.confidence_note: The credit, 7 days, two sandboxes, sizes and timeouts, card gate, sign-in options, network default and the per-size rates are quoted from the vendor's pricing pages read on 2026-11-24. The signup page quote establishes the email and social options.
